selected_candidate.selection_unit: MACrossoverStrategy operational behavior on the fixed ETF basket
selected_candidate.execution_semantics: MACrossoverStrategy.Analyze followed by signal type != HOLD, confidence >= 0.60, deterministic research/risk validity checks, next-session-open hypothetical evaluation
selected_candidate.pullback_branch: excluded from actionable candidate: source emits 0.55 confidence and the operational gate rejects it; it is not reintroduced in VAL-03

hypothesis.question: Whether the frozen operational bullish MA-alignment rule produces positive net directional edge beyond a matched non-signal long ETF placebo after the frozen personal base cost model.
hypothesis.population: actionable bullish episodes from SPY, QQQ, IWM, DIA, XLK, XLF, XLE, TLT and GLD
hypothesis.trigger: daily regular-session close with SMA20 > SMA50 > SMA200 and close > SMA20, followed by the operational gate
hypothesis.entry_timestamp: next regular US equity session open strictly after signal close
hypothesis.holding_horizon: first frozen stop/target or twentieth future regular-session close
hypothesis.primary_claim: long-only tradable edge; bearish signals remain secondary directional research diagnostics
hypothesis.predicted_effect: positive mean net strategy return and positive mean paired difference versus the frozen matched non-signal placebo

confidence_contract.formula: base 0.65 + 0.12 when directional MarketTrend agrees + 0.08 when Volume > AvgVolume20 + 0.10 when abs(SMA20-SMA200)/SMA200 > 0.05 in the signal direction, capped at 1.00
confidence_contract.market_trend: bullish iff SMA20 > SMA50 > SMA200; bearish iff SMA20 < SMA50 < SMA200; otherwise neutral
confidence_contract.avg_volume20: arithmetic mean of the last 20 eligible volumes
confidence_contract.probability_calibration: NOT_APPLICABLE; confidence is a heuristic eligibility score, not a probability

indicator_contract.sma20: arithmetic mean of the last 20 eligible raw closes
indicator_contract.sma50: arithmetic mean of the last 50 eligible raw closes
indicator_contract.sma200: arithmetic mean of the last 200 eligible raw closes
indicator_contract.atr14: arithmetic mean of the last 14 true ranges; true_range=max(high-low, abs(high-previous_close), abs(low-previous_close)); first bar without previous close excluded
indicator_contract.avg_volume20: arithmetic mean of the last 20 eligible raw volumes
indicator_contract.window_rule: only bars available through the signal-session close; insufficient, invalid or non-finite history abstains

price_and_corporate_action_contract.dividend_treatment: not used as alpha or primary return credit; future forward-paper accounting remains required prospectively
price_and_corporate_action_contract.split_treatment: split-adjusted signal/geometry; synchronized raw bars for execution reference; detected structural boundary triggers 200 valid post-split-session reset
price_and_corporate_action_contract.rounding: carry high-precision arithmetic; round displayed monetary outputs only to cents using round-half-up

val03b_bar_family_contract.factor_contract: derive split_adjusted OHLC / raw OHLC; require one positive common factor within relative tolerance 5e-4 for provider quote-precision rounding; require inverse volume relation where non-zero
val03b_bar_family_contract.factor_boundary: adjacent-session factor change; action type is not inferred from price return
val03b_bar_family_contract.synchronization: all three families must have identical session keys and strict chronological order
val03b_bar_family_contract.spin_off_policy: any SPLIT versus SPLIT_SPIN_OFF adjustment boundary is UNSUPPORTED_STRUCTURAL_ACTION before performance evaluation
val03b_bar_family_contract.holdout_guard: reject request end or returned provider date >= 2025-01-01
val03b_bar_family_contract.raw_persistence: persist exact provider bytes before normalization with provider/feed/timeframe/adjustment/asof request identity and content hash
val03b_bar_family_contract.adapter_identity: libs/marketdata/alpaca_hardened.go explicit adjustment identities and adjustment-bearing source/normalizer identities

protocol.entry: next regular US equity session open strictly after signal close
protocol.pre_entry_gap_rule: long valid only when stop < next_open < target; otherwise PRE_ENTRY_INVALIDATED, abstention and no episode
protocol.short_diagnostic_gap_rule: short diagnostic valid only when target < next_open < stop; otherwise PRE_ENTRY_INVALIDATED, abstention and no episode
protocol.exit: first operational target or stop touched after valid entry, otherwise close of twentieth future regular session
protocol.intrabar_order: next-open crossing at the open; later opening cross at the open; otherwise touched levels at the level; stop before target when both are touched
protocol.gap_fill: open is the only fill reference for an opening cross; no impossible fill outside the observed bar
protocol.session_calendar: deterministic Jax US regular-session calendar with UTC storage and America/New_York interpretation
protocol.overlap_baseline: one non-overlapping episode per instrument; later signals during an active episode are suppressed/no-trade observations
protocol.missing_data: typed abstention; never impute, backfill or create an episode

exit_contract.target_selection: first TakeProfit only; second source target ignored because scheduler persists TakeProfit[0]
exit_contract.quantity_allocation: 100 percent of episode quantity; no partial profit or scale-out
exit_contract.time_exit: close of twentieth future regular session

bearish_economics.primary_claim: not included in the primary tradable-edge claim
bearish_economics.secondary_role: retain SELL episodes as directional research diagnostics; do not delete, tune away or use to rescue a failed long claim
bearish_economics.historical_borrow_support: NOT POINT-IN-TIME SUPPORTED under the approved zero-spend dataset boundary
bearish_economics.reason: repository contains no historical ETF borrow availability/fee series and IBKR describes symbol-specific, time-varying borrow and proceeds economics
bearish_economics.future_short_promotion: requires a new preregistered point-in-time borrow, financing, availability and dividend-liability contract

primary_base.broker_plan: IBKR Pro Fixed, US exchange-listed stocks and ETFs
primary_base.regulatory_exchange_pass_through: not separately modelled; account/route-specific charges unavailable from daily OHLCV remain an explicit limitation
primary_base.source_rationale: official IBKR Fixed schedule supplies commission facts; 4 bps spread and 5 bps slippage are existing Jax daily/swing modelling assumptions for liquid ETFs; zero impact is a bounded base assumption, not an IBKR fact

stress.role: LEGACY DETERMINISTIC FIXTURE / CONSERVATIVE STRESS SCENARIO ONLY
stress.application: long-only stress applies commission, spread, slippage and impact on both legs; preserved borrow field is not applied to the primary claim

analysis_units.return_denominator: actual deployed entry_notional, not fixed 10000 USD
analysis_units.episode_net_return: (net exit cash value - net entry cash outlay + point-in-time long dividend cash) / actual deployed entry_notional

primary_metric.name: MEAN_NET_LONG_RETURN_PER_NON_OVERLAPPING_EPISODE
primary_metric.formula: M = arithmetic mean of base-cost net_return over eligible primary long episodes
primary_metric.direction_symmetric: YES for the primary long claim; BUY is the only primary tradable direction
primary_metric.comparative_gate: mean paired net_return difference between each actual long episode and its deterministic matched non-signal placebo must exceed zero under the same block bootstrap
primary_success_requires: 95 percent instrument-year block-bootstrap lower bound for M above zero
positive paired actual-minus-placebo mean with lower bound above zero

secondary_benchmarks.primary_comparator: deterministic matched non-signal fixed-horizon long placebo
secondary_benchmarks.placebo_outcome: whole-share long entry at placebo next open, exit at twentieth future regular-session close, same cost model and point-in-time dividend treatment; no strategy stop/target transferred
secondary_benchmarks.rationale: fixed-horizon geometry avoids assigning an arbitrary signal stop/target to a non-signal date

randomisation.primary_sign_permutation: NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_PRIMARY_LONG_ONLY CLAIM; secondary directional diagnostic only

secondary_sign_permutation.procedure: SHA-256 counter-derived independent +/- assignments for mixed-direction diagnostic observations
secondary_sign_permutation.seed: first eight big-endian bytes of SHA-256(frozen_manifest_sha256 || |secondary-sign-permutation-v1|)

randomisation.all_randomness: domain-separated SHA-256 counter-derived bytes; no wall-clock or process-global RNG

bootstrap.interval: percentile 95 percent interval; lower bound is the 2.5th percentile
bootstrap.seed_derivation: first eight big-endian bytes of SHA-256(frozen_manifest_sha256 || |instrument-year-bootstrap-v2|)
bootstrap.paired_placebo: resample blocks and carry actual/placebo pairs together; recompute arithmetic mean paired difference

eligibility: raw bars and point-in-time corporate-action provenance
timestamp_placebo.selection: rank eligible dates by SHA-256(seed || replicate || instrument || candidate_date) ascending and choose first; no relaxation

match_fields: same broad pre-signal regime: SPY close above/below available SMA200
matched_non_signal.selection: smallest absolute trading-session distance, SHA-256 tie-break using frozen manifest and both dates
matched_non_signal.no_match: record missing; actual episode remains; paired gate is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE below pair floor
matched_non_signal.outcome: fixed-horizon long from placebo next open to twentieth future close with selected costs and dividends

robustness_variants.atr_scope: stop and target distance only; ATR period, true-range formula and eligibility remain fixed
robustness_variants.top_5_percent_contribution_exclusion: sort primary episodes by net_return descending; remove max(1, ceil(0.05*N)) highest-return episodes and retain identities
robustness_variants.overlap_sensitivity: retain earliest signal per instrument in each 20-trading-session entry-date window; compare descriptively with baseline actual-exit non-overlap
robustness_variants.replacement_rule: variants are falsification only and cannot replace the original candidate

primary.raw_artifact_storage: persist raw provider bytes before normalization with content hash, request identity, retrieval timestamp and source identity

provider_acquisition_order.fallback_trigger: if primary cannot provide complete frozen range/feed/adjustment/provenance, stop as DATASET_BLOCKED; do not shop providers

universe.membership: fixed ETF basket; no replacement for closure, delisting or termination
universe.delisted_or_closed: retain if historical data exists; otherwise record missing coverage and do not substitute a survivor

partitions.holdout_access: metadata/schema/hash only; no bars, signals, counts, returns, calibration or semantics

tests: secondary mixed-direction sign permutation where applicable
falsification_suite.registration_rule: exact list; failures retained; no post-OOS additions

failure_rules: effect only in one unregistered slice
